parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); const assignmentId=String(b.assignmentId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,assignmentId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Closed Deal Archive Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const s=ctx.settlement??{}; const r=ctx.reconciliation??{}; const p=ctx.property??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??{}; const buyer=ctx.buyer??{}; const flags=[]; const n=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const closed=ctx.lifecycleState==='closed'||d.lifecycleState==='closed'||d.status==='closed'; const settlementReconciled=ctx.settlementReconciled===true||s.reconciled===true; const financialReconciled=ctx.financialReconciled===true||r.status==='reconciled'; const transactionCompleted=ctx.transactionCompleted===true||d.transactionCompleted===true; if(!closed)flags.push('deal_not_closed'); if(!settlementReconciled)flags.push('settlement_not_reconciled'); if(!financialReconciled)flags.push('financial_reconciliation_missing'); if(!transactionCompleted)flags.push('transaction_completion_missing'); const grossRevenue=n(d.grossRevenue??s.grossRevenue??r.financials?.grossRevenue); const assignmentFee=n(d.assignmentFee??s.assignmentFee??r.financials?.assignmentFee); const closingCosts=n(d.closingCosts??s.closingCosts??r.financials?.closingCosts)??0; const otherCosts=n(d.otherCosts??s.otherCosts??r.financials?.otherCosts)??0; const netProfit=n(d.netProfit??s.netProfit??r.financials?.netProfit)??(grossRevenue!==null?grossRevenue-closingCosts-otherCosts-(n(d.purchasePrice??s.purchasePrice)??0):null); const roiBase=n(d.totalInvestment??d.purchasePrice??s.purchasePrice); const roi=netProfit!==null&&roiBase!==null&&roiBase!==0?netProfit/roiBase:null; const profitMargin=grossRevenue!==null&&grossRevenue!==0&&netProfit!==null?netProfit/grossRevenue:null; const closedAt=ctx.closedAt??d.closedAt??ctx.closingCompletedAt??null; const archiveRecord={dealId:input.dealId,assignmentId:input.assignmentId,leadId:input.leadId,propertyId:input.propertyId,status:'closed',closedAt,property:{address:p.address??null,propertyType:p.propertyType??null,beds:p.beds??null,baths:p.baths??null,sqft:p.sqft??null},participants:{sellerId:seller.id??ctx.sellerId??null,buyerId:buyer.id??ctx.buyerId??null},financials:{grossRevenue,assignmentFee,closingCosts,otherCosts,netProfit,roi,profitMargin},source:ctx.source??d.source??null,campaignId:ctx.campaignId??d.campaignId??null}; const ready=flags.length===0; const decision=ready?'archive_and_finalize_closed_record':'hold_archive_until_reconciliation_complete'; const idempotencyKey='wf427:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId+':'+input.assignmentId; return [{json:{...input,closedDealArchive:{status:ready?'ready':'blocked',decision,flags,archiveRecord,finalKpi:{grossRevenue,assignmentFee,closingCosts,otherCosts,netProfit,roi,profitMargin},nextAction:ready?'write_final_closed_record_and_release_to_portfolio_analytics':'complete_missing_close_or_reconciliation_steps',confidenceScore:ready?99:Math.max(0,70-flags.length*12)},idempotencyKey}}];
